# Document tabs (`document-tabs`)

Closable editor tabs with unsaved dot.

Group: Navigation. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/navigation';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createDocumentTabs` (types in `dist/web/navigation/documentTabs.d.ts`): `.mh-document-tabs`: a scrolling `role="tablist"` of `.mh-document-tabs__tab`s (`.is-selected`, `.is-dirty`), each a `button.__select` (`role="tab"`, roving `tabindex`) and a `button.__close` (out of the tab order; Delete closes the focused tab, middle click closes too). A dirty tab shows `__dirty`, a dot, until the close button is hovered or focused. Optional `button.__add` after the list. Left and Right arrows, Home and End move between tabs.

```ts
export function createDocumentTabs(options: DocumentTabsOptions): DocumentTabsHandle;

export interface DocumentTabsOptions {
  tabs: readonly DocumentTab[];
  /** Selected tab id; default the first. */
  value?: string;
  /** Accessible name of the tab list. */
  label?: string;
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
  /**
   * The user closed a tab (close button, middle click, Delete). Return false to keep it, e.g. to ask about unsaved
   * changes first and call `closeTab` later.
   */
  onClose?: (id: string) => unknown;
  /** Shows a "new tab" button at the end of the row. */
  onAdd?: () => void;
  addLabel?: string;
  /** Label of each close button; default "Close". */
  closeLabel?: string;
}

export interface DocumentTabsHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  value(): string;
  setValue(id: string): void;
  setTabs(tabs: readonly DocumentTab[]): void;
  setDirty(id: string, dirty: boolean): void;
  /** Removes a tab without asking (`onClose` isn't called); selects a neighbour if it was selected. */
  closeTab(id: string): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createDocumentTabs, type DocumentTab } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let files: DocumentTab[] = [
  { id: 'evening', label: 'Evening.yaml', dirty: true },
  { id: 'morning', label: 'Morning.yaml' },
  { id: 'away', label: 'Away.yaml' },
];
let created = 0;

const editor = createDocumentTabs({
  label: 'Open scenes',
  tabs: files,
  value: 'evening',
  onClose: (id) => {
    const file = files.find((f) => f.id === id);
    // Returning false keeps the tab open.
    if (file?.dirty && !confirm(`Close ${file.label} without saving?`)) return false;
    files = files.filter((f) => f.id !== id);
    return true;
  },
  onAdd: () => {
    created += 1;
    const id = `new-${created}`;
    files = [...files, { id, label: `Untitled ${created}.yaml` }];
    editor.setTabs(files);
    editor.setValue(id);
  },
});

document.body.append(editor.el);
```

## React API

`DocumentTabs` (types in `dist/react/navigation.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createDocumentTabs`; controlled through `tabs`, `value`, `onChange` and `onClose`.

```ts
export function DocumentTabs({ tabs, value, onChange, onClose, onAdd, addLabel = 'New tab', closeLabel = 'Close', label }: DocumentTabsProps);

export interface DocumentTabsProps {
  tabs: readonly DocumentTab[];
  /** Controlled: the selected tab id. */
  value: string;
  onChange: (id: string) => void;
  /** The user closed a tab; `next` is the tab to select if it was the selected one. Remove it from `tabs` to close it. */
  onClose?: (id: string, next: string) => void;
  onAdd?: () => void;
  addLabel?: string;
  closeLabel?: string;
  label?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { DocumentTabs } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { DocumentTab } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function DocumentTabsExample() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<DocumentTab[]>([
    { id: 'evening', label: 'Evening.yaml', dirty: true },
    { id: 'morning', label: 'Morning.yaml' },
    { id: 'away', label: 'Away.yaml' },
  ]);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState('evening');

  const close = (id: string, next: string) => {
    setFiles((all) => all.filter((f) => f.id !== id));
    if (id === open) setOpen(next);
  };
  const add = () => {
    const id = `new-${Date.now()}`;
    setFiles((all) => [...all, { id, label: 'Untitled.yaml' }]);
    setOpen(id);
  };

  return <DocumentTabs label="Open scenes" tabs={files} value={open} onChange={setOpen} onClose={close} onAdd={add} />;
}
```
